data.description: The Tai Chi is our single-user spinner, with two orange hand wheels set on a frame at chest height. The user stands facing the wheels and turns them in slow circles, which loosens the shoulders, upper back and wrists. It needs no strength to start and is often the first machine older users try in a new open gym. Because it is small, it fits beside a bench along a walking track or in a corner of a society garden. Play Orange is the listed finish for the single Tai Chi in our Fun Fitness range. Our team will send its size and warranty terms along with the quote. Our standard terms give 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings, which we will confirm with your quote.

items.pText: The Tai Chi is our single-user spinner, with two orange hand wheels set on a frame at chest height. The user stands facing the wheels and turns them in slow circles, which loosens the shoulders, upper back and wrists. It needs no strength to start and is often the first machine older users try in a new open gym. Because it is small, it fits beside a bench along a walking track or in a corner of a society garden. Play Orange is the listed finish for the single Tai Chi in our Fun Fitness range. Our team will send its size and warranty terms along with the quote. Our standard terms give 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings, which we will confirm with your quote.

Each wheel runs on its own bearing, so turn both by hand at each maintenance visit and grease any that feel rough. This compact unit is usually installed self-standing on a firm slab. Keep the standing area in front of the wheels dry and even.
